Representative Nico Rios calls for accountability over alleged cover-ups by local officials
V. S. Pineda
Representative Nico Rios, a public official, made several statements on his Twitter account on June 17, 2026, addressing issues related to local authorities and law enforcement responses in an unspecified case. In his posts, Rios called for accountability among officials and criticized the handling of reported crimes.
In a tweet posted at 01:34 UTC, Rios stated: "Watch for anyone on our side looking the other way? No. We need to watch for anyone on our side not calling for the heads of the local politicians, police, media, health and school officials who covered this up for decades. There needs to be an organized attempt to list everyone".
Later that morning at 04:51 UTC, he commented on the actions of a call handler involved in a missing person report: "Yea so the call handler that told the victims mother as she reported her missing 'You can't describe them as Asian bc that's racist.' That person also deserves the death penalty. As much as the cop who returned the victim to her abusers.".
On June 17 at 22:24 UTC, Rios referenced President Joe Biden in another post: "SHOOT EM IN THE LEG - Joe Biden".
Rios’s comments reflect ongoing public debates about accountability within institutions such as law enforcement and local government when responding to reports of abuse or misconduct. His reference to Joe Biden echoes past controversies regarding policing tactics attributed to statements by Biden during his presidency.
